name: @equin/plugin-framework-tooling-web-artifacts-served-addresses
description: A served dist's address dir and its bound: retainAddresses (an address stays while a graph needing it — composed, served or named by an open tab — was needed within a day), servedGraphOf, publishReleaseDist — a release host served from the same per-namespace layout (web.live.<run>, web-addresses, web-graphs), so a ship never deletes what an open tab still loads — and the backend's touch of every graph an open tab names.
